_about: Every threshold in one place. Read by the Python pipeline (explorer/settings.py) and the front-end prototype (frontend/src/lib/settings.ts). Change a value here only, and log the change in the Change Log.
limitationLine: Unusual activity requires investigation; it does not indicate wrongdoing.

collection._failoverHoldSeconds: after repeated HTTP 429s from one host, use the other for this long (plan §6.2: switch to mempool.space for an hour)

corpus._sources: keys of settings.source to crawl from; Blockstream allows only 700 unauthenticated requests per hour per IP, far too few for DS2

bitcoinheist.name: BitcoinHeist Ransomware Address Dataset (UCI Machine Learning Repository, dataset 526)
bitcoinheist.citation: Akcora, C.G., Li, Y., Gel, Y.R. and Kantarcioglu, M. (2020) BitcoinHeist: topological data analysis for ransomware prediction on the Bitcoin blockchain. IJCAI-PRICAI 2020.

elliptic.name: Elliptic Data Set (Kaggle)
elliptic.citation: Weber, M. et al. (2019) Anti-money laundering in Bitcoin: experimenting with graph convolutional networks for financial forensics. KDD '19 Workshop on Anomaly Detection in Finance.

features._sizeComparisonOptions: same-direction (proposed CR-04: size features compared only with earlier transactions in the same direction) or all (report §2.3 as written)
features._zClip: own-history z-scores are clipped to +/- this before pooled models (plan §6.2), so one extreme value cannot dominate

featuresAsWritten._about: The method exactly as A1 §2.3 wrote it, for the refinement ablation (plan §6.2): a plain 30-day window with no extension (CR-02), all directions (CR-04), no log transform of F3/F4 and no floor on the spread (CR-05). Every other value comes from features and baseline.

bitcoinheist._about: DS4 processing (plan §6.4). Features exclude address, year and day; year only defines splits.
bitcoinheist._log1pIfSkewAbove: log(1+x) for weight, count, looped and neighbors when their skewness exceeds this (plan: 'if the analysis confirms heavy tails'); income is always log10

classification._about: Model grids for DS3 and DS4 (plan §9.4). Random searches draw nIter configurations with the seed.
classification._rfMaxSamples: rows drawn for each tree's bootstrap; bounds memory and time on DS4 (the plan's grid grows full-depth trees on ~400k rows, several GB for 600 trees)
